_why: Budgets for the family homework pages (docs/family-homework-v3/brief-stage2.md, workstream A). `target` is the brief; `ratchet` is today's measured worst page and may only go DOWN, so a regression cannot hide behind a target nobody meets yet. The effective limit is the smaller of the two numbers that is still above the measurement: lower `ratchet` to the new maximum whenever a change reduces weight, and remove it once it reaches `target`.

actions._why: data-act attributes are declarative (no code); capped so the replacement for inline handlers cannot grow back into 1,000 per page
